requirements.title: One Containerfile with two targets and its build context
requirements.rationale: Both images share one module download and one source tree, and the build is the same on a developer's machine and on the release runner. If psx's cgo variant fails to link without CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW, the work stops and the failure is recorded in docs/errata/16_sandbox_images.md instead of being worked around (DD 19).

criteria.action: build the base image under `--target base` and the overlay image under `--target overlay`, with the repository root as the build context, where the overlay target copies only from the static build stage
criteria.contract: `<engine> build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target base .` and `--target overlay .`, each run from the repository root, exit 0 and produce one image each

criteria.action: run every build stage `FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.27-trixie` with `GOTOOLCHAIN=local` set, and copy go.mod and go.sum and run `go mod download` before copying the rest of the source
criteria.contract: a go directive in go.mod that is newer than the builder's toolchain fails the build instead of downloading a toolchain

setup: the Containerfile split into stages as in TS-16-10; a build stage is every stage other than base and overlay
the go directive read from go.mod

criteria.action: compile ./sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd in the cgo stage with CGO_ENABLED=1, GOOS=linux and GOARCH=$TARGETARCH, and in the static stage with CGO_ENABLED=0, both with `-trimpath`, `-buildvcs=false` and `-ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=${AGENTKIT_VERSION}"`
criteria.contract: the cgo-built agent reports OutlineBackend "tree-sitter"; the static agent runs in an image that holds no libc

criteria.condition: TARGETARCH differs from BUILDARCH
criteria.action: install Debian's crossbuild-essential-$TARGETARCH in the cgo stage and set CC to x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc for amd64 or aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc for arm64
criteria.contract: a linux/arm64 build on an amd64 builder, and the reverse, compiles the cgo agent on the build platform without emulating the target

setup: the Containerfile split into stages as in TS-16-10
an engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE set, so this runs only in the opt-in run
the cgo stage name and the binary's source path read from the base stage's `COPY --from=<stage> <src> <AgentPath>`
the other architecture: arm64 when runtime.GOARCH is amd64, else amd64
check.pseudocode:
r = runText(cgoStage); assert contains(r,'crossbuild-essential-') && comparesArch(r,'TARGETARCH','BUILDARCH')
assert branch(r,'amd64').sets('CC','x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc') && branch(r,'arm64').sets('CC','aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc')
for s in [cgoStage, staticStage]: g = defaultBranch(runText(s)); assert g.exitsNonZero && contains(g.msg,'linux/amd64') && contains(g.msg,'linux/arm64') && idx(g) < idx(goBuild(s))
stage, src = cgoCopy(stages(cf)['base']); other = runtime.GOARCH == 'amd64' ? 'arm64' : 'amd64'
ref = 'agentkit-imgtest-cgo-'+hex(); assert run(engine,'build','-f','sandbox/images/Containerfile','--target',stage,'--platform','linux/'+other,'--build-arg','AGENTKIT_VERSION=v9.8.7','-t',ref,'.').code == 0
id = run(engine,'create',ref).out; run(engine,'cp',id+':'+src,tmp+'/agent'); t.Cleanup(rm(id), rmi(ref))
assert elf.Open(tmp+'/agent').Machine == machineFor(other)
bi = buildinfo.ReadFile(tmp+'/agent'); assert bi.setting('GOOS') == 'linux' && bi.setting('GOARCH') == other && bi.setting('CGO_ENABLED') == '1' && bi.setting('-trimpath') == 'true' && has(bi.setting('-ldflags'),'buildver.stamp=v9.8.7')

criteria.condition: TARGETARCH is neither amd64 nor arm64
criteria.action: fail the build before compiling the agent
criteria.contract: the build exits non-zero with a message naming linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 as the two supported platforms

setup: an engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE set, so this runs only in the opt-in run
the cgo stage name read as in TS-16-49

criteria.action: declare the build arguments AGENTKIT_VERSION and AGENTKIT_REVISION, both defaulting to empty, and set neither CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW nor any environment variable other than GOTOOLCHAIN, CGO_ENABLED, GOOS, GOARCH and CC
criteria.contract: the Containerfile text contains no CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW; a build with no build arguments stamps nothing

criteria.action: exclude .git, .github, .specs, .claude, build, codesearch, docs, coverage.*, *.test and .DS_Store from the build context, and exclude neither go.mod, go.sum nor any directory that holds a root-module package
criteria.contract: for every package that `go list ./...` reports in the root module, no .dockerignore pattern matches its directory, and every listed exclusion is present

setup: the root .dockerignore read with comment and blank lines dropped, and each pattern trimmed of a leading and trailing /
`go list -f '{{.Dir}}' ./...` run from the module root, each directory made relative to the root

requirements.title: The base image
requirements.rationale: The base image is the default sandbox: a small Debian image with exactly git, bash and ca-certificates, a numeric non-root user, and a root-owned agent laid out to match 15's Landlock roots.

criteria.action: be built FROM debian:trixie-slim with git, bash and ca-certificates installed with --no-install-recommends and the apt lists removed afterwards, and contain no rsync, curl or tini
criteria.contract: inside the container, `git --version` and `test -s` of the CA bundle exit 0, while `command -v rsync` and `command -v curl` exit non-zero

setup: the Containerfile split into stages as in TS-16-10
the base image attached as in TS-16-38
each command run through the proxy execute tool as `<command>; echo rc=$?`, with the exit code parsed from the output
check.pseudocode:
b = stages(cf)['base']; assert b.from == 'debian:trixie-slim'
i = aptInstalls(b); assert len(i) == 1 && '--no-install-recommends' in i[0].flags && set(i[0].pkgs) == {'git','bash','ca-certificates'} && removesAptLists(i[0].run)
assert no token in ['rsync','curl','tini'] occurs in b
assert instr(b,'USER') == ['1000:1000'] && instr(b,'WORKDIR') == ['/workspace']
assert no VOLUME in any stage && no ENV in base or overlay
rc, out = exec(sb, 'git --version'); assert rc == 0 && startsWith(out,'git version')
assert exec(sb,'test -x /bin/bash').rc == 0 && exec(sb,'test -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt').rc == 0
for c in ['rsync','curl','tini']: assert exec(sb,'command -v '+c).rc != 0
assert !has(exec(sb,'ls /var/lib/apt/lists').out,'_Packages')
assert trim(exec(sb,'git config --system --get-all safe.directory').out) == '*'

criteria.action: define user agentkit with uid 1000, group agentkit with gid 1000, home /home/agentkit owned 1000:1000 and login shell /bin/bash, and declare `USER 1000:1000` in numeric form
criteria.contract: `id -u` and `id -g` run through proxy execute each print 1000; `image inspect` reports Config.User "1000:1000"

setup: the base image attached as in TS-16-38, commands run as in TS-16-39
an engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE as in TS-16-38
check.pseudocode:
assert trim(exec(sb,'id -u').out) == '1000' && trim(exec(sb,'id -g').out) == '1000'
p = split(exec(sb,'getent passwd agentkit').out, ':'); assert p[2:4] == ['1000','1000'] && p[5] == '/home/agentkit' && p[6] == '/bin/bash'
assert trim(exec(sb,"stat -c '%u %g %a' /workspace").out) == '1000 1000 755' && lines(exec(sb,'stat -c %u /workspace /home/agentkit').out) == ['1000','1000']
assert trim(exec(sb,"stat -c '%u %a' "+AgentPath).out) == '0 755' && exec(sb,'test -w '+AgentPath).rc != 0
r = call(sb,'write_file',{path:'probe.txt',content:'x'}); assert !r.IsError && exec(sb,'cat /workspace/probe.txt').out == 'x'
c = inspectConfig(engine, base)
assert c.User == '1000:1000' && c.Entrypoint == [AgentPath] && c.WorkingDir == '/workspace' && len(c.Volumes) == 0
assert {split(e,'=')[0] for e in c.Env} <= {'PATH'}

criteria.action: create /workspace owned 1000:1000 with mode 0755, set `WORKDIR /workspace`, and declare no VOLUME
criteria.contract: `stat -c %u /workspace /home/agentkit` prints 1000 twice; Config.Volumes is empty; Agent().Workdir is "/workspace"; a proxy write_file of probe.txt succeeds

criteria.action: set `safe.directory = *` in the system git config
criteria.contract: `git config --system --get-all safe.directory` prints `*`

criteria.action: hold the cgo-built agent at sandbox.AgentPath, owned 0:0 with mode 0755, and set `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd"]`
criteria.contract: `stat -c '%u %a'` of the agent prints `0 755`; Config.Entrypoint is [sandbox.AgentPath]; Agent().OutlineBackend is "tree-sitter" and Agent().Git is true

criteria.action: declare no ENV beyond what debian:trixie-slim already sets
criteria.contract: the variable names in Config.Env are a subset of {PATH}

criteria.action: carry the labels org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go, org.opencontainers.image.licenses=Apache-2.0, org.opencontainers.image.title, org.opencontainers.image.description, org.opencontainers.image.version from AGENTKIT_VERSION and org.opencontainers.image.revision from AGENTKIT_REVISION
criteria.contract: Config.Labels carries exactly the source and licenses values above, and non-empty title and description values

setup: an engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE as in TS-16-38; the overlay half runs only when AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE is also set
check.pseudocode:
for img in [base, overlay if set]: L = inspectLabels(engine, img)
  assert L['org.opencontainers.image.source'] == 'https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go' && L['org.opencontainers.image.licenses'] == 'Apache-2.0'
  assert L['org.opencontainers.image.title'] != '' && L['org.opencontainers.image.description'] != '' && L.get('org.opencontainers.image.version','') == getenv('AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION') && 'org.opencontainers.image.revision' in L
assert pick(Lbase, keys4) == pick(Loverlay, keys4)

criteria.condition: an agent started from the base image reports Agent().Landlock.ABI of 2 or more
criteria.action: place /home/agentkit, /tmp and /workspace under 15's writable roots and every other path the tools use under its read-only system directories, so that the Landlock check passes
criteria.contract: through proxy execute, `touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe` exits non-zero and `touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p` exits 0

setup: the base image attached as in TS-16-38; when Agent().Landlock.ABI is below 2 the Landlock helper logs the note and this check does not run (TS-16-25)
check.pseudocode:
a = sb.Agent(); if a.Landlock.ABI < 2: t.Log(a.Landlock.Note); return
assert exec(sb,'touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe').rc != 0
assert exec(sb,'touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p').rc == 0

requirements.title: The overlay image and derived images
requirements.rationale: An embedder who needs a toolchain adds the agent to its own image with one COPY line, so the overlay must be a single static file and that exact line must work.

criteria.action: be built FROM scratch with a single COPY of the static agent to sandbox.AgentPath, so that the image has exactly one layer, holding the agent owned 0:0 with mode 0755
criteria.contract: `image inspect` reports exactly one entry in RootFS.Layers

setup: the Containerfile split into stages as in TS-16-10
an engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE naming an overlay image built by make sandbox-images; otherwise the test skips per 16-REQ-7.1
check.pseudocode:
o = stages(cf)['overlay']; assert count(o,'RUN') == 0 && count(o,'ADD') == 0 && count(o,'COPY') == 1
c = copies(o)[0]; assert c.from == staticStage && c.dest == AgentPath && c.chown in [none,'0:0'] && c.chmod in [none,'755','0755']
assert entrypoint(o) == ['/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd']
for s in ['base','overlay']: L = labels(s); assert L['org.opencontainers.image.source'] == 'https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go' && L['org.opencontainers.image.licenses'] == 'Apache-2.0' && L['...title'] != '' && L['...description'] != '' && L['...version'] == '${AGENTKIT_VERSION}' && L['...revision'] == '${AGENTKIT_REVISION}'
assert labels('base') == labels('overlay')
assert len(inspectJSON(engine, overlay, '.RootFS.Layers')) == 1 && inspectJSON(engine, overlay, '.Config.Entrypoint') == [AgentPath]
out, code = run(engine,'run','--rm','--entrypoint',AgentPath,overlay,'--version'); assert code == 0 && out == sprintf('agentkit-sandboxd %s (protocol %d.%d)\n', expected, ProtocolMajor, ProtocolMinor)

criteria.action: set `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd"]` and carry the same OCI labels as the base image
criteria.contract: Config.Entrypoint is [sandbox.AgentPath]; `run --rm --entrypoint <AgentPath> <overlay> --version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd <expected version> (protocol M.N)`, which proves the binary runs with no libc

criteria.condition: an image is built from a context whose Containerfile is `FROM <base image>` followed by the single line sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay ref>)
criteria.action: run the copied static agent when the harness starts it
criteria.contract: Agent().OutlineBackend is "none", Agent().Version is the expected version, Tools(ctx, ToolOptions{}) passes the digest check, and proxy execute of `echo ok` exits 0

setup: an engine and both AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE set; the derived part skips when the base variable is unset
a temp context whose Containerfile is exactly "FROM <base>\n" + sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay>) + "\n"
check.pseudocode:
dir = tmp(); write(dir+'/Containerfile', 'FROM '+base+'\n'+sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(overlay)+'\n')
ref = 'agentkit-imgtest-derived-'+hex(); assert run(engine,'build','-t',ref,dir).code == 0; t.Cleanup(rmi(ref))
sb = harness.start(t, ref); a = sb.Agent(); assert a.OutlineBackend == 'none' && a.Version == expected
ts, err = sb.Tools(ctx, sandbox.ToolOptions{}); assert err == nil && len(ts) > 0
r = exec(sb,'echo ok'); assert r.rc == 0 && trim(r.out) == 'ok' && trim(exec(sb,"stat -c '%u %a' "+AgentPath).out) == '0 755'
assert landlockCheck(a, execVia(sb), t) == nil

criteria.condition: an agent started from the derived image reports Agent().Landlock.ABI of 2 or more
criteria.action: pass the same Landlock check as the base image
criteria.contract: through proxy execute, `touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe` exits non-zero and `touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p` exits 0

requirements.title: The build-time version stamp
requirements.rationale: An explicit build argument stamps the same version locally and in CI, without .git in the context or a tag-aware checkout (DD 4).

criteria.action: declare an unexported package variable `stamp string` with no initializer, set only through `-ldflags -X`, and leave the package's exported API unchanged
criteria.contract: `go doc -all ./sandbox/internal/buildver` lists the same exported identifiers as before this spec

setup: the non-test .go files of sandbox/internal/buildver parsed with go/parser
check.pseudocode:
files = parseDir('sandbox/internal/buildver', nonTest)
assert exportedTopLevel(files) == {'Version'}
v = findVar(files, 'stamp'); assert v.Type == 'string' && len(v.Values) == 0
assert no AssignStmt with LHS ident 'stamp' in files

criteria.condition: stamp is non-empty
criteria.action: return stamp from Version()
criteria.contract: with stamp set to "v0.6.0", Version() returns "v0.6.0"

setup: an in-package test file sandbox/internal/buildver/stamp_test.go (package buildver) that saves stamp and restores it with t.Cleanup, and does not call t.Parallel
an independent oracle in the test: debug.ReadBuildInfo, the github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go entry from Main or Deps, its Version, or "(devel)" when that is absent or empty
check.pseudocode:
saved := stamp; t.Cleanup(func(){ stamp = saved })
stamp = "v0.6.0"; assert Version() == "v0.6.0"
stamp = ""; assert Version() == oracleFromBuildInfo()

criteria.condition: stamp is empty
criteria.action: return from Version() exactly what 13 specified: the agentkit-go module version from runtime/debug build info, or `(devel)` when that is absent or empty
criteria.contract: after the in-package test clears stamp, Version() returns the build-info value; a host binary that never sets the stamp reports the same version as before this spec

criteria.condition: agentkit-sandboxd is built with `-ldflags "-X github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=v9.8.7"` and run with --version
criteria.action: print the stamped version
criteria.contract: stdout is `agentkit-sandboxd v9.8.7 (protocol <ProtocolMajor>.<ProtocolMinor>)`, formatted from sandbox.ProtocolMajor and sandbox.ProtocolMinor, and the exit code is 0; the command test that builds it into a temp dir skips under -short

setup: the go toolchain on PATH; the test is skipped under -short
the module path read from `go list -m` equals github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
check.pseudocode:
if testing.Short(): skip
bin = tmp+'/agentkit-sandboxd'
run('go','build','-ldflags','-X '+mod+'/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=v9.8.7','-o',bin,'./sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd')
out, code = run(bin,'--version')
assert code == 0 && out == sprintf('agentkit-sandboxd v9.8.7 (protocol %d.%d)\n', ProtocolMajor, ProtocolMinor)

criteria.condition: an image is built with AGENTKIT_VERSION empty
criteria.action: produce an agent that reports `(devel)`, because the context carries no .git and the build uses -buildvcs=false
criteria.contract: Agent().Version is "(devel)" and `--version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd (devel) (protocol M.N)`

setup: both images built by `make sandbox-images-test` with AGENTKIT_VERSION left empty, so AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION is empty and the expected version is (devel)
an engine and both image variables set
check.pseudocode:
assert getenv('AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION') == ''
assert harness.start(t, base).Agent().Version == '(devel)'
for img in [base, overlay]: out, code = run(engine,'run','--rm','--entrypoint',AgentPath,img,'--version'); assert code == 0 && out == sprintf('agentkit-sandboxd (devel) (protocol %d.%d)\n', ProtocolMajor, ProtocolMinor)
  assert inspectLabels(engine,img).get('org.opencontainers.image.version','') == ''

criteria.condition: an image is built with AGENTKIT_VERSION set to a version such as v0.6.0
criteria.action: produce an agent that reports that version in Hello and in --version
criteria.contract: Agent().Version is "v0.6.0" and `--version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd v0.6.0 (protocol M.N)`

requirements.title: Image references in package sandbox
requirements.rationale: The publishing pipeline and the code that names the images must agree, and a build with no published image must get an explicit error, not a nearby release that might fail the digest check.

criteria.action: export from sandbox/image.go the constants BaseImageRepo = "quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox" and OverlayImageRepo = "quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd", and the variable ErrNoPublishedImage = errors.New("sandbox: no published image for this agentkit-go version")
criteria.contract: BaseImageRepo == "quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox", OverlayImageRepo == "quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd" and ErrNoPublishedImage.Error() == "sandbox: no published image for this agentkit-go version"; for v1.2.3 the builder yields ("quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:1.2.3", nil) and ("quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:1.2.3", nil); for v1.2.3-rc.1 the tags are 1.2.3-rc.1; DefaultImage() and OverlayImage() return exactly what the builder returns for buildver.Version() with BaseImageRepo and OverlayImageRepo respectively, reference and error alike

setup: an internal test in package sandbox that can call the unexported reference builder
check.pseudocode:
assert BaseImageRepo == 'quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox' && OverlayImageRepo == 'quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd'
assert ErrNoPublishedImage.Error() == 'sandbox: no published image for this agentkit-go version'
assert build(BaseImageRepo,'v1.2.3') == ('quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:1.2.3', nil)
assert build(OverlayImageRepo,'v1.2.3') == ('quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:1.2.3', nil)
ref, err = DefaultImage(); wref, werr = build(BaseImageRepo, buildver.Version()); assert ref == wref && (err == nil) == (werr == nil)

criteria.condition: ImageTag receives a canonical release version
criteria.action: return the version without its leading `v`
criteria.contract: ImageTag("v0.6.0") returns ("0.6.0", true) and ImageTag("v1.2.3-rc.1") returns ("1.2.3-rc.1", true)

setup: the table test for ImageTag in sandbox/image_test.go

criteria.condition: the version passed to ImageTag is empty, is `(devel)`, carries `+` build metadata (including +dirty and +incompatible), lacks the leading `v`, has a leading zero in a numeric part, or is otherwise not canonical
criteria.action: refuse the version
criteria.contract: ImageTag returns ("", false)

setup: the same table test for ImageTag
check.pseudocode: for v in refusals: tag, ok = ImageTag(v); assert tag == '' && ok == false

criteria.condition: the version passed to ImageTag is a pseudo-version in any of its three forms
criteria.action: refuse the version
criteria.contract: ImageTag returns ("", false) for v0.0.0-20240102150405-abcdefabcdef, v1.2.4-0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef and v1.2.3-pre.0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef

criteria.condition: ImageTag accepts the version that buildver.Version() reports
criteria.action: return BaseImageRepo + ":" + tag from DefaultImage and OverlayImageRepo + ":" + tag from OverlayImage, both thin wrappers over one unexported function that takes the version as a parameter
criteria.contract: for version v1.2.3 the unexported builder yields ("quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:1.2.3", nil) and ("quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:1.2.3", nil)

criteria.condition: ImageTag refuses the build's version
criteria.action: return an empty reference and an error from DefaultImage and OverlayImage
criteria.contract: errors.Is(err, ErrNoPublishedImage) is true, and the message names the version, Spec.Image and `make sandbox-images`

setup: the same internal test in package sandbox
check.pseudocode:
for repo in [BaseImageRepo, OverlayImageRepo]: for v in ['(devel)','','v1.2.4-0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef','v1.2.3+dirty']:
  ref, err = build(repo, v)
  assert ref == '' && errors.Is(err, ErrNoPublishedImage)
  assert contains(err.Error(), v) && contains(err.Error(), 'Spec.Image') && contains(err.Error(), 'make sandbox-images')

criteria.action: return "COPY --from=" + ref + " " + AgentPath + " " + path.Dir(AgentPath) + "/" from OverlayCopyLine(ref)
criteria.contract: OverlayCopyLine("x:1") returns `COPY --from=x:1 /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd /usr/local/libexec/`

setup: sandbox.AgentPath == "/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd"
check.pseudocode:
assert OverlayCopyLine('x:1') == 'COPY --from=x:1 /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd /usr/local/libexec/'
ref = 'quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:0.6.0'
assert OverlayCopyLine(ref) == 'COPY --from='+ref+' '+AgentPath+' '+path.Dir(AgentPath)+'/' && !contains(OverlayCopyLine(ref), '\n')

criteria.action: for any string v for which ImageTag(v) returns ok, guarantee that "v" + tag equals v, that v contains no `+`, and that v is not a pseudo-version
criteria.contract: whenever ImageTag(v) returns ok, "v" + tag == v and tag is non-empty; whenever ImageTag(v) returns ok, v contains no + and the pseudo-version oracle rejects it; whenever ImageTag(v) returns not ok, tag is ""; two calls with the same input return the same result

setup: math/rand/v2 with a fixed seed and 5000 iterations
an independent pseudo-version oracle: the prerelease matches (^|\.)[0-9]{14}-[0-9a-f]{12}$

requirements.title: Make targets
requirements.rationale: One make target builds both images for the host platform with podman or docker, and a second runs the end-to-end tests against them, outside make check.

criteria.action: define these variables, each overridable on the make command line: CONTAINER (podman when on PATH, else docker); SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE (quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox); SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE (quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd); SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG (dev); SANDBOX_PLATFORM (empty); AGENTKIT_VERSION (empty); AGENTKIT_REVISION (`git rev-parse HEAD`, or empty outside a checkout)
criteria.contract: with PATH=A the build commands start with podman; with PATH=B they start with docker; by default the tags are quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:latest and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:latest, no --platform is passed, AGENTKIT_VERSION is passed empty, and AGENTKIT_REVISION is passed as the output of `git rev-parse HEAD` (checked only when git is found); with the overrides the commands use docker, example.com/b:t1, example.com/o:t1, --platform linux/arm64, AGENTKIT_VERSION=v1.0.0 and AGENTKIT_REVISION=abc; in the temp directory outside a checkout, AGENTKIT_REVISION is passed empty

setup: make on PATH, else the test skips; make is invoked by absolute path
stub directory A holding executable podman and docker stubs, stub directory B holding only a docker stub, each also holding a symlink to git when git is found
a temp directory outside any git checkout holding a copy of the Makefile
check.pseudocode:
out = makeN('sandbox-images', PATH=A); assert all(buildLines(out) startswith 'podman ')
out = makeN('sandbox-images', PATH=B); assert all(buildLines(out) startswith 'docker ')

resolves CONTAINER and runs `build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target base` and then `--target overlay`, passing AGENTKIT_VERSION and AGENTKIT_REVISION and tagging both :dev references
download modules, compile agentkit-sandboxd with cgo and statically with `-X …buildver.stamp=v0.6.0`, and assemble the base and overlay images
runs `go test -count=1 -v ./sandbox/images/` with the AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_* variables and AGENTKIT_CONTAINER set
runs `run --rm -i --network none --entrypoint <AgentPath> <base> <AgentArgs(spec)…>`, wraps the pipes with stdioconn.New and attaches with attach.Dial
applies its Landlock ruleset and answers Hello with Version v0.6.0, Workdir /workspace, OutlineBackend tree-sitter and Git true
call Tools, which passes the digest check, and run proxy execute and write_file probes as uid 1000 inside /workspace
closes the sandbox and removes the container; go test reports PASS and make exits 0

real_components: agentkit-sandboxd, cgo and static builds with the buildver stamp
the sandbox/images harness, stdioconn.New and attach.Dial
the proxy execute and write_file tools
setup: a Linux or macOS host with podman or docker and network access to pull debian:trixie-slim and golang:1.27-trixie
a checkout of the repository
end_state: make exits 0, and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:latest and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:latest both exist in the engine's image store

the go test output reports PASS, not SKIP, for the base image test, whose agent answered Hello with Version v0.6.0, Workdir /workspace, OutlineBackend tree-sitter and Git true, and whose Tools call and proxy execute and write_file probes succeeded
`run --rm --entrypoint /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd <image> --version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd v0.6.0 (protocol M.N)` for both :dev images

execution_paths.title: An embedder adds the agent to its own image with the overlay COPY line

steps.action: calls sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay ref>) and writes a Containerfile of `FROM <base ref>` followed by that line into a temporary context
builds the derived image, copying the static agent from the overlay image to /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd
starts the derived image with `--entrypoint <AgentPath>` and sandbox.AgentArgs(spec), and attaches with attach.Dial
answers Hello with OutlineBackend none and the expected version
call Tools, which passes the digest check, and run proxy execute of `echo ok`, which exits 0
closes the sandbox and removes the container and the derived image

real_components: podman or docker building from the local base and overlay images
the static agentkit-sandboxd copied from the overlay image
the sandbox/images harness, stdioconn.New and attach.Dial
setup: the images from TS-16-51 and the same make sandbox-images-test run, with both image variables set
end_state: the go test output reports PASS, not SKIP, for the derived-image part
the copied agent answered Hello with OutlineBackend none and Version v0.6.0, Tools passed the digest check, and echo ok exited 0
after the test, the derived image reference is absent from `$CONTAINER images` and no agentkit-imgtest-* container remains

execution_paths.title: A maintainer publishes a release by pushing a version tag

steps.action: pushes the git tag vX.Y.Z to github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
validates GITHUB_REF_NAME against the version pattern and computes the tags X.Y.Z and X.Y
runs `make sandbox-images-test CONTAINER=docker SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG=ci AGENTKIT_VERSION=vX.Y.Z AGENTKIT_REVISION=$GITHUB_SHA` on the default docker builder, and the tests pass
sets up QEMU and buildx, logs in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, and pushes both targets for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 with every computed tag
pulls each repository, tag and platform anonymously and runs `--version`, which prints `agentkit-sandboxd vX.Y.Z (protocol M.N)`

real_components: make sandbox-images-test with docker's default builder
ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN and anonymous pulls
setup: the release workflow on the default branch of github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
both GHCR packages public (on the first release, made public after the first verify run fails, then verify re-run alone)
end_state: the images job's test step passed on the default docker builder before the QEMU, buildx, login and push steps ran, and the job succeeded

`docker buildx imagetools inspect` of quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd at X.Y.Z and X.Y lists linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, the arm64 cgo agent having been cross-compiled on the amd64 runner

the verify job succeeded without logging in, and an anonymous `docker pull --platform linux/arm64` of each tag followed by `--entrypoint /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd … --version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd vX.Y.Z (protocol M.N)`

execution_paths.title: An embedder's binary resolves the default image for its agentkit-go version

steps.action: built against agentkit-go at a release version, or stamped with `-X …buildver.stamp=vX.Y.Z`, calls sandbox.DefaultImage() and sandbox.OverlayImage()
returns the stamp when set, else the agentkit-go module version from build info, else (devel)
passes the version to ImageTag, which accepts a canonical release and refuses (devel), pseudo-versions and build metadata
returns quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:X.Y.Z and quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:X.Y.Z, or an error wrapping ErrNoPublishedImage that names the version, Spec.Image and `make sandbox-images`

setup: the go toolchain; the test skips under -short
sandbox/testdata/imageref/main.go, which prints DefaultImage() and OverlayImage() on two lines and exits 0, or prints the error to stderr and exits 1
end_state: the v1.2.3 binary exits 0 and prints quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandbox:1.2.3 then quay.io/agentfox/agentkit-sandboxd:1.2.3
the unstamped binary exits 1 and its stderr contains "sandbox: no published image for this agentkit-go version", "(devel)", "Spec.Image" and "make sandbox-images"
the pseudo-version binary exits 1 and its stderr contains the same error text and v1.2.4-0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef
